# Authorized confirmation-2 — synthetic

Permit past calendar dates. The original “reject before today” restriction is withdrawn. Reject only impossible date input; leaving the field blank means no expiry. Expiry is informational for manual review and must never trigger automatic sending or deletion. Published announcements stay immutable. The technical team may choose an equivalent persistent representation preserving calendar date/absence semantics. No database write or migration is authorized by this document-design fixture.
